---
title: "sFig5"
output: html_notebook
---

Download libraries.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

Download RData from the folder.
```{r}
# Load RData file containing data required for analysis and visualization.
load("multiple_cohorts_data.RData")

source("FunctionCollection.R")

# Define a list of datasets (unique study ID)
datasets <- c("PHS000452_GSE91061","PRJEB23709","SU2CMARK")

# The clinical and gene expression data is stored as df_tf.
df_tf <- df_tf %>%
  distinct(SampleID, StudyID, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_C1_pre <- df_tf %>% 
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") %>%
  dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_C2_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[2] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_NSCLC_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[3] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

# Combine all pre-tx samples from three cohorts
df_pre <- rbind(df_C1_pre, df_C2_pre, df_NSCLC_pre)
```

```{r}
# Define list of immune cell type
cell_types <- c("B.cells.naive","B.cells.memory","Plasma.cells",
                "T.cells.CD8","T.cells.CD4.naive","T.cells.CD4.memory.resting","T.cells.CD4.memory.activated",
                "T.cells.follicular.helper","T.cells.regulatory..Tregs.","T.cells.gamma.delta",
                "NK.cells.resting","NK.cells.activated",
                "Monocytes","Macrophages.M0","Macrophages.M1","Macrophages.M2",
                "Dendritic.cells.resting","Dendritic.cells.activated",
                "Mast.cells.resting","Mast.cells.activated",
                "Eosinophils","Neutrophils"
                )
```


Cohort 1 Pre-Tx Top 50% IRF2/50% aCD4Tm - Plot survival curves.
```{r}
df_in <- df_pre %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1] & BiopsyTime == "Pre")

FigS5_C1_IRF2_High_aCD4Tm_P50 <- plot_km_nested_subset(df = df_in,
                                           geneA = "IRF2",
                                           geneB = "T.cells.CD4.memory.activated",
                                           splitA = 50, 
                                           splitB = 50, 
                                           subsetA = "High",
                                           subgroup_col = NULL, 
                                           norm_type = "log2", 
                                           cell_types = cell_types, 
                                           max_years = 5, 
                                           show_metrics = "both", 
                                           landmark_years = 1)

FigS5_C1_IRF2_High_aCD4Tm_P50$plot
```

FigS5 <- ggarrange(FigS5_C1_IRF2_High_aCD4Tm_P50$plot,
                   FigS5_C1_IRF2_Low_aCD4Tm_P50$plot,
                   FigS5_C2_IRF2_High_aCD4Tm_P50$plot,
